sql: SELECT co.name AS empresa, coalesce(l.status::text,'sem lead') AS status, c.last_message_from_me AS nos_por_ultimo, (c.bot_data->'ai_handoff'->>'at') IS NOT NULL AS ia_passou, count(*) AS qtd FROM wapi_conversations c JOIN companies co ON co.id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = c.lead_id WHERE c.bot_step = 'human_takeover' AND c.bot_data->>'ai_agent' = 'on' AND c.remote_jid NOT LIKE '%@g.us' AND c.last_message_at > now() - interval '14 days' AND c.last_message_at < now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,5 DESC
